name: Ossian Conceal Shoulder Harness Mk-4
description:
A cross-draw shoulder harness in dark espresso bridle leather over a matte black nylon frame, designed to sit beneath a jacket at Tier 4 professional dress standard. The holster body is precision-molded synthetic leather with passive retention — no snaps, no audible draw. Secondary strap carries a slim mag or tool pouch opposite the draw side.

Hardware is brushed black steel throughout. Adjustment points are silent velcro-backed, avoiding the telltale click of traditional buckles. The harness spreads load across both shoulders and is tailored to clear spinal aug rigs and standard chrome shoulder joints.
functionality: Passive retention holster for standard sidearm profiles. Silent adjustment and draw. Secondary pouch for mags, medpen, or slim tools. Cleared for standard spinal aug rigs and chrome shoulder joints. Sits flat under structured jackets.
what_it_says: You operate in rooms where weapons aren't supposed to exist — and you've planned for that.
story_hooks: The harness is stamped with a defunct corponation's internal serial — the original owner was someone whose death was ruled accidental.
A Tier 5 client requests the wearer disarm before entry; the harness's passive retention makes a silent, compliant draw possible if things go wrong.
Ossian has received a cease-and-desist from Redline Armory claiming design patent overlap — every unit sold now carries legal ambiguity.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Proprioceptive Lattice Sleeve

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist cross-draw harness that sits flush against the torso beneath outer layers. Clean diagonal lines from shoulder to hip create an athletic, purposeful silhouette. When worn under a jacket, only subtle leather edges and the secondary pouch peek through at the collar and ribcage. On display, the harness reads as architectural and refined — almost jewelry-like in its precision engineering.
physical_description.fit: Tailored compression fit that conforms to the body without bulk. Designed to distribute weight evenly across both shoulders and spine, accommodating standard augmentation profiles without interference or pressure points. Shoulder straps sit naturally without slipping, and the cross-angle positions the primary holster at mid-ribs for discretion.
physical_description.primary_material: Dark espresso bridle leather (full-grain, vegetable-tanned) over matte black nylon tactical frame. Premium leather ages gracefully with a developing patina; nylon core provides structural integrity and aug-rig compatibility.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, burnished leather with subtle hand-tooled edges. Nylon backing is matte and gripless. Velcro adjustment strips are soft to the touch but robust under repeated use. Hardware has a satin brushed finish — non-reflective and tactile.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep espresso brown leather with matte black nylon frame and brushed black steel hardware throughout. No visible logos or branding except discrete stamped 'OSSIAN' inside the holster body. Monochromatic, professional, understated.
physical_description.closures: Silent velcro-backed adjustment points (no clicks, no snaps). Holster retention is passive — form-fitted synthetic leather body with zero audible or mechanical engagement. Designed for corporate discretion and sub-second deployment.
distinctive_features: Passive retention holster (no snaps or mechanical delay)
Cross-draw geometry optimized for seated or vehicle environments
Secondary slim mag/tool pouch on opposite side for load balancing
Spinal-aug clearance engineering built into shoulder strap routing
Chrome shoulder joint compatibility — tested with standard Tier 2-3 cyberlimbs
Silent velcro adjustment eliminates tactical audio signature
Hand-stitched leather edges with reinforced stress points
Aged patina aesthetic suggests well-maintained professional use
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 professional. Premium independent craftsmanship at Φ420-580 price point. Signals serious intent without corpo-logo ostentation. Accessible to security, private contractors, and disciplined working-class operators.
physical_description.cultural_context: Corporate security, private investigation, or high-end personal protection. Worn by those who need concealed carry capability but maintain a professional facade. The choice of Ossian Leatherworks (independent, not corpo-standardized) suggests individualism within a structured profession — someone who invests in quality over regulation.
physical_description.condition_typical: Arrives pristine but develops character with use. Leather darkens and softens with wear; scratches and scuff marks build an authentic patina of professional use. Well-maintained examples show no visible fraying, and hardware retains its brushed finish. Signs of regular draw practice (subtle creasing at holster mouth) are badges of competence.
